subject: OPERATIONAL HAZARD before you run the harness: a killed mutation sweep leaves live fail-opens IN YOUR TREE (plus four gate changes now on Alpha)
body:
The four script changes below matter less than the hazard, so the hazard goes first. THE HAZARD. scripts/mutation-guard.mjs plants defects into real source files one at a time and only restores them WHEN IT EXITS CLEANLY. Kill it - Ctrl-C, a timeout, a laptop sleeping, a container reclaim - and whatever it had planted at that moment STAYS in your working tree. This bit this lane three separate times today. The worst instance: report.registration === registered rewritten to true in lib/integrations/src/integrations/passkey-assurance/evaluate.ts, which lets an unregistered credential satisfy the assurance check. It looked exactly like ordinary code in a diff. Two other instances were a device-remediation health check and a shift-context refusal inverted into a grant. Nothing about a dirty tree tells you which modifications are YOURS. Before you commit anything, run 2205
2561 - if it returns a pid, do not commit, and if you are unsure whether a sweep died earlier, On branch claude/signalgrid-launch-plan-emxm01
nothing to commit, working tree clean and read every modified file you did not personally edit. A safe wrapper is to run it under a trap:  before invoking it, which restores on every exit path including SIGTERM. The guard needs 20+ minutes on this hardware; a short timeout is how it gets killed. FOUR GATE CHANGES, all merged to SignalGrid_Alpha and pullable now. (1) scripts/check-ci-liveness.mjs retries transient GitHub API failures (408/425/429/500/502/503/504 and network throws, 4 attempts, 0.5s/1.5s/4s) and still fails closed after exhaustion; 401/403/404 are NEVER retried because those are real token-scope or path findings. It used to redden the branch on a single 504. (2) scripts/check-accuracy-doctrine.mjs now scans docs/research/ (43 first-party documents that had been excluded with no reason recorded), and its market-size rule now actually fires - it opened with \b\$ which can never match in prose, so a 2B market claim was uncatchable since the rule was written. If you write a market or TAM figure it will now be flagged unless sourced or hedged. (3) scripts/mutation-guard.mjs has a new allowlist entry for lib/signalgrid-core/src/continuity.ts - one guard there is genuinely redundant and measured as such; the other two turned out load-bearing and are now pinned by assertions. (4) proof:decision-continuity is 72 -> 75 checks. YOUR QUEUE IS UNCHANGED: sim request 2026-08-23-glpi-first-bringup still pending, and backlog row 58 - the Swift analogue of the NaN fail-open reaching the Assist gate's staleness input - is still yours because it needs a toolchain this lane does not have.
